methodology: Tehran open-market sell/buy rate, collected hourly. When the sources stop quoting, the last good rate is kept with its own asOf and stale turns true after 6 hours; deltaDayPct and delta7dPct are then as of asOf, not now. Toman is the spoken-language unit (1 Toman = 10 Rial). deltaDayPct and delta7dPct compare midRial against earlier readings. basis is "direct" when the source quoted a dollar rate and "cross-aed" when it did not and the figure is implied from the UAE dirham rate at the 3.6725 peg.
